label: D1 after an unrewarded trial, agent about to choose a1, late in episode
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (96% of mass; never at D2, weakly at GO during long a1-reward streaks) when the reward input is 0 (prev trial unrewarded: 96% of mass; reward=1 input almost fully suppresses it). Within that it is strongly biased toward the agent preparing a1 (upcoming action a1 / positive choice logit; 83% of mass) and grows with episode trial (rate 0.2% in trials 0-9 to 9.8% in 90-99) and with low value. The FUTURE variable used is only the agent own upcoming choice (action at D1), which it computes; no future reward/transition is used. The observed-only alternative (phase==D1)&(prev_reward==0) has recall 0.89, mass recall 0.96 but precision 0.21 (F1 0.34). Precision remains incomplete: many unrewarded-D1 a1 steps are silent, so magnitude/history beyond these variables matters.
